dossera.title: Dossera JAMS
dossera.subtitle: Sovereign Judicial Archive Management System — Digitizing justice for courts, law firms, notary offices, and legal institutions across Morocco and beyond.

description.intro: Dossera JAMS (Judicial Archive Management System) is a sovereign, on-premise platform digitizing judicial archives for courts, law firms, notary offices, and government institutions across Morocco. Built with a decoupled client-server architecture, it transforms how judicial institutions manage, search, and secure their critical documents.
description.role: As Technical Project Lead & Full Stack Developer, I architected and delivered the entire system — from translating complex legal requirements into technical specifications to deploying a production-ready platform serving real users daily.
description.results: The system is successfully deployed in production at the Court of First Instance of Khouribga, with a second deployment validated at the Court of Appeal. It delivers measurable results: a 30% reduction in administrative processing time and complete data confidentiality for sensitive judicial documents.

ocr.title: Intelligent OCR
ocr.description: Multilingual document scanning (Arabic/French) powered by Tesseract.js with 98%+ accuracy. Transform paper archives into searchable digital assets instantly.

search.title: Hybrid Semantic Search
search.description: Combining Meilisearch full-text indexing with pgvector semantic vector search for instant, context-aware document retrieval across your entire archive.

archiving.title: Immutable Archiving
archiving.description: MinIO S3-compatible object storage with AES-256 encryption at rest. Certified retention with SHA-256 digital signatures for legal compliance.

rbac.title: RBAC & Audit Trail
rbac.description: Role-based access control (Magistrate, Clerk, Administrator, Auditor) with immutable timestamped logging of every action for complete accountability.

cache.title: 3-Tier Cache Architecture
cache.description: L1 LRU in-memory (< 1ms), L2 Redis Cluster, L3 PostgreSQL/MinIO. Achieving 99.9% cache hit rate for lightning-fast document access.

onPremise.title: 100% On-Premise
onPremise.description: Zero mandatory cloud dependency. Full data sovereignty with Proxmox VE hypervisor, pfSense firewall, and 5 isolated VLANs for maximum security.

khouribga.court: Court of First Instance of Khouribga
khouribga.description: First production deployment serving dozens of daily users. Successfully digitized judicial procedures, achieving a 30% reduction in administrative processing time.

appeal.description: Full deployment validated with Proxmox VE, pfSense 5-VLAN architecture, complete SOC stack, and comprehensive team training delivered.

services.title: Our Services
services.description: We help legal institutions digitize their archives with a comprehensive, secure, and sovereign solution. From initial assessment to full deployment and training — we handle the entire transformation.

notary.title: Notary Offices

government.title: Government Institutions
government.description: Enterprise-grade document management with military-grade security, real-time monitoring, and full data sovereignty on your own infrastructure.

security.title: Security Stack
security.network: Network: pfSense firewall, 5 isolated VLANs (Staff, Archives, DMZ, SOC, Honeypot)
security.monitoring: Monitoring: Wazuh SIEM, CrowdSec, T-Pot honeypot, Prometheus + Grafana
security.compliance: Compliance: GDPR, Moroccan Law 09-08, SHA-256 signatures, AES-256 encryption

week1.description: Proxmox VE hypervisor deployment, pfSense firewall configuration, VLAN segmentation, and network routing.

week4.description: Comprehensive team training, Wazuh SIEM integration, disaster recovery plan (PRA) delivery, and production validation.
